subject: AtlasCloud CAIQ - CCM responses and evidence package
messages:
From: Joanna Li <joanna.li@atlascloud.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AtlasCloud Security Team <security@atlascloud.io>
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ request -- CCM mapping + evidence (target May 14)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. AtlasCloud is starting a procurement review and we need Redwood's CAIQ responses mapped to the CSA CCM. Our procurement window targets May 14 for final review. Can you provide: 1) a filled CAIQ spreadsheet mapping each question to your control IDs, 2) supporting evidence stubs (SOC2 Type II report, architecture diagram, IAM policy excerpts), and 3) a short summary of any compensating controls or known gaps?

If you prefer, a shared Drive package works. We typically redact incident timestamps but need high-level descriptions.

Please let me know who on your side will own the deliverable and a realistic ETA.

Appreciate it,
Joanna
Joanna Li
Security Sr. Manager, Vendor Risk
AtlasCloud

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Joanna Li <joanna.li@atlascloud.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ request -- CCM mapping + evidence (target May 14)

Hi Joanna — thanks for the note and the timeline. We can assemble a package for May 14; planning to deliver an initial package by end of day Monday (May 10) and iterate if you need clarifications.

Karthik will coordinate logistics and delivery, and Neha (InfoSec) will own the control-level evidence and redaction guidance.

Karthik / Neha — could you confirm:
- Owner for the CAIQ spreadsheet population (I suggest Security fill the control answers, Product/Infra to supply architecture diagrams)
- Whether we need a formal NDA before sending the SOC2 PDF (Joanna, please advise if you require an NDA)
- Any controls you want prioritized (Joanna, please call out PII/data residency, logging/retention, and encryption controls if they are high priority)

Joanna — we'll attach a Drive link with the spreadsheet and evidence stubs. If possible, can you confirm whether AtlasCloud requires unredacted incident descriptions? We typically provide redacted incident timelines and scope but can discuss granularity.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ request -- CCM mapping + evidence (target May 14)

On it. Proposed breakdown:
- Neha: populate CAIQ answers for 200-level controls and collect evidence links (SOC2 pages, policy excerpts, audit logs retention statement).
- Infra/Product: provide network architecture diagram and key config snippets (we'll ask Infra separately).
- Sales (me) will package the Drive link and cover note for AtlasCloud and handle any commercial questions (pricing, SLA).

Neha, do we have a recent SOC2 Type II 2025 PDF that can be shared redacted? If not, I'll ask Legal to push an NDA. Also tagging the controls Joanna flagged: data residency/PII, logging/retention (audit.log retention = 90 days by default), encryption at rest in KMS, key rotation cadence.

Karthik
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 11:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ request -- CCM mapping + evidence (target May 14)

Thanks — quick status and evidence plan:
- SOC2: We have redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf (final, unredacted) in the Security Drive. For external sharing we'll export a redacted version removing specific incident timestamps and names; standard redaction notes included.
- CAIQ template: starting a spreadsheet and pre-filling applicable responses where we already have canonical controls (control IDs: INF-ENC-01, AUD-RET-03, IAM-ROLE-02, etc.).
- Arch diagram: request infra for network_arch_diagram_v3.pdf (expected Monday AM).
- Evidence index: I'll create evidence_index_readme.txt listing file to control mappings and a suggested Review Notes column for you to send to AtlasCloud.

Drive link: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/teams/security/CAIQ/AtlasCloud-package-20260510 (access: redwood-security + guest link)

Open items for Joanna: preferred level of redaction (full redaction vs. high-level summary) and whether AtlasCloud requires signed NDA prior to SOC2.

Neha
Security and Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Joanna Li <joanna.li@atlascloud.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Deliverable: CAIQ mapping and evidence package (AtlasCloud)

Hi Joanna — attaching the initial package per our plan. Files attached: 20260510_redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx (CAIQ responses mapped to CCM controls with control IDs), redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf (redacted for external sharing), network_arch_diagram_v3.pdf, and evidence_index_readme.txt which explains each attachment and points to the canonical internal docs.

Highlights / caveats:
- Controls mapped where we have an operational control or policy; where we rely on third-party cloud provider controls it's noted in the spreadsheet with the provider name.
- Retention: audit logs retained for 90 days by default; longer retention available by contract.
- Encryption: data at rest encrypted with customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/private customers; hosted defaults to Redwood-managed KMS with envelope encryption.
- Gaps: a few administrative separation controls are handled via change control processes rather than strict role separation; those are documented as compensating controls in the spreadsheet.

Drive package (same link): https://drive.redwoodinference.com/teams/security/CAIQ/AtlasCloud-package-20260510
Deliverables attached:
- 20260510_redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx (attachment: spreadsheet)
- redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf (attachment: pdf - redacted)
- network_arch_diagram_v3.pdf (attachment: pdf)
- evidence_index_readme.txt (attachment: txt)

If you need unredacted SOC2 under NDA, or a short call to walk the controls, we can accommodate. Suggested times: Tue May 11 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed May 12 14:00-15:00 PT.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Joanna Li <joanna.li@atlascloud.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AtlasCloud Security Team <security@atlascloud.io>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deliverable: CAIQ mapping and evidence package (AtlasCloud)

Marissa — many thanks, this is extremely helpful and the spreadsheet looks comprehensive. Two quick clarifications before we start our internal review:
1) For data residency, can you confirm which regions hosted customers may be placed in by default? We need explicit regional options per account (US, EU, APAC).
2) We noticed the audit log retention note — please confirm whether the 90 days is for all logs (application + infra) or only application-level audit logs.

If those can be answered in a short reply, we'll proceed with the procurement review. Otherwise we may ask for a brief call.

Thanks again,
Joanna
